content.cn:
v26.3.0 正式发布！这一次，八种点名工具住进了同一个工作台，抽奖也换上了更稳的记账方式。

本次更新重点包括：

- 点名工具整合为八合一工作台：滚动、翻牌、转盘、光轨穿梭、座次寻光、流萤传灯、花笺藏名、连星成诗
- 座次寻光支持粘贴 Excel/CSV/TSV 座位表，标记缺席、交换座位；光轨穿梭可一次抽齐并逐个揭晓
- 抽奖新增花信盲盒与刮开好运，支持批量抽取，抽前可看库存与概率
- 奖品库存与记录改为统一事务：抽中即扣库存，揭晓不再重复扣减；旧数据自动迁移
- Dock 合并为单一「点名工具」入口，窄屏导航改为抽屉，旧翻牌链接仍然可用

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.3.0 is now officially released! Eight name-picking tools now share one workspace, and prize draws use a safer, transactional inventory ledger.

Highlights include:

- All eight roll-call tools in one workspace: Roller, Cards, Wheel, Light Tunnel, Seat Spotlight, Firefly Relay, Petal Riddle, and Constellations
- Seat Spotlight accepts Excel/CSV/TSV seating charts, attendance marking, and seat swaps; Light Tunnel draws a batch and reveals names together or one by one
- Prize draws add Bloom Boxes and Scratch & Reveal, batch draws, and a live odds/stock preview
- Prize inventory and history now commit as one transaction: drawing consumes stock once, revealing never consumes it again, and legacy data migrates automatically
- The Dock now has a single Roller entry, narrow screens use a navigation drawer, and old Card links still work

See Settings → Changelog for the full list, and use GitHub Issues for feedback.

content.cn:
v26.2.4 正式发布！本次带来插件清单拆分与设置控件页面化，并完成 API 1.5 残留清理。

本次更新重点包括：

- 插件清单拆分为 manifest.yml + contributions.json；插件设置控件迁移到页面视图，由宿主 Fluent 组件渲染
- 清理已撤销的 API 1.5 残留代码；旧 1.5 插件仍会被识别并提示「已撤销，仅可查看」
- Windows 悬浮窗支持触摸拖拽
- Web 插件目录 Release 解析支持 CORS 镜像回退；预热 Core Worker 并重绑名单选择
- 修复设置页滚动恢复与悬停页面抖动
- 新增进程保活防冻结机制（Windows）：禁用 WebView2 遮挡/后台化冻结与后台节流，并关闭系统电源节流
- 修复点名点击停止瞬间的短暂卡顿：停止时并行发起抽取事务，滚动持续到结果返回后再揭晓

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.2.4 is now officially released. This update brings the split plugin manifest with page-based settings, plus a full cleanup of revoked API 1.5 leftovers.

Highlights include:

- Plugin manifests are split into manifest.yml + contributions.json; plugin settings controls moved to the page view and are rendered by host Fluent components
- Removed revoked API 1.5 leftovers; legacy 1.5 packages are still recognized and shown as revoked/read-only
- The Windows floating window now supports touch dragging
- Web plugin catalog release resolution falls back through CORS mirrors; the Core Worker is prewarmed and list selection is rebound
- Fixed settings scroll restoration and hover-induced page jitter
- Added a Windows process keep-alive: WebView2 occlusion/background freezing and background throttling are disabled, along with system power throttling
- Fixed the brief stutter when Stop is pressed: the draw now starts in parallel while the roll keeps spinning until the result returns

See Settings → Changelog for the full list, and use GitHub Issues for feedback.

content.cn:
v26.2.3 正式发布！本版本集中修复了数据路径、窗口恢复与触屏滚动上的几个老问题。

本次更新重点包括：

- 移除便携模式开关，数据固定在安装目录并自动从 AppData 迁移
- 修复启动后窗口变细条：非法尺寸拒绝写入，并按习惯尺寸自愈（默认 1280×720）
- 数据向下兼容：未知字段保留不删，回退旧版仍可读取
- 禁用触屏滑到底部的回弹；点名滚动减少 DOM 重渲染

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.2.3 is now officially released. This release focuses on long-standing issues around data paths, window restore, and touch scrolling.

Highlights include:

- Portable mode removed; data always lives under the install directory with automatic AppData migration
- Fixed the thin-strip window on startup: illegal sizes are rejected and restored from habitual size (default 1280×720)
- Downward-compatible data: unknown fields are preserved so rolling back still works
- Disabled touch overscroll bounce; roller hot path reduces DOM re-renders

See Settings → Changelog for the full list, and use GitHub Issues for feedback.

content.cn:
v26.2.2 正式发布！本版本在不减少任何视觉效果的前提下降低 CPU 与内存占用，让程序在老旧平台上更加流畅。

本次更新重点包括：

- 横幅倒计时改为合成器驱动动画，视觉逐帧一致，主线程不再每 100ms 更新
- 构建分包优化冷启动（入口包 814KB → 445KB）
- 保留全部动画效果，性能模式行为与旧版完全一致
- Windows 安装器自动适配系统语言（中文/英文）、显示 GPL-3.0 许可证、图标与程序一致

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.2.2 is now officially released. This version reduces CPU and memory usage without removing any visual effects, making the app smoother on older hardware.

Highlights include:

- Banner countdowns are compositor-driven with frame-identical visuals; no more per-100ms main-thread updates
- Build splitting improves cold start (entry chunk 814KB → 445KB)
- All visual effects preserved; performance-mode behavior identical to the previous version
- The Windows installer auto-adapts to the system language (Chinese/English), shows the GPL-3.0 license, and uses the app icon

See Settings → Changelog for the full list, and use GitHub Issues for feedback.

content.cn:
v26.2.1 正式发布！本版本修复了 v26.2.0 的构建失败问题，并恢复 Release、GitHub Pages 与插件 SDK 的发布流程。

本次更新重点包括：

- 移除设置页中重复声明的悬浮窗样式同步函数，修复构建失败
- 发布流程全面统一使用 bun，安装、测试与构建更加稳定

详细内容可在「设置 → 更新日志」查看。欢迎通过 GitHub Issues 反馈问题与建议。
content.en:
v26.2.1 is now officially released. This version fixes the v26.2.0 build failure and restores the Release, GitHub Pages, and Plugin SDK publishing pipelines.

Highlights include:

- Removed duplicate floating-window style sync declarations in Settings that broke the build
- All publishing pipelines now consistently use bun for more stable installs, tests, and builds

See Settings → Changelog for the full list, and use GitHub Issues for feedback.
